scripts.audit:frontends: npm --prefix creator-frontend audit --audit-level=low && npm --prefix operator-frontend audit --audit-level=low
scripts.lint:frontends: npm --prefix creator-frontend run lint && npm --prefix operator-frontend run lint
scripts.build:frontends: npm --prefix creator-frontend run build && npm --prefix operator-frontend run build
scripts.scan:all: npm run audit && npm run build && npm run audit:frontends && npm run lint:frontends && npm run build:frontends
